_help: Invite and earn (js/affiliate.js, supabase/025_affiliates.sql). Only people with a published web3.toys page earn. tiers: the share of what their buyers pay, by paying buyers brought in so far; keep the same numbers in affiliate_tiers in 025_affiliates.sql (a test compares them). The waiting time, the $20 minimum, the 90 day link window, the 12 month invite window and the rupee rate are in affiliate_settings (rupee rate: admin, Affiliates). Words: edit freely, keep them true.
title: Invite and earn
line: Share your link. When people you bring in buy anything on web3.toys, you get a share, paid in USDC or USDT.
rules: Counts when someone joins with your link (for 12 months), or arrives through it or your web3.toys page and buys within 90 days.
Every paid purchase counts: reports, certificates, Pro pages, Quests, ad slots, toy and test deposits. Coin unlocks do not.
One inviter per buyer: the first link wins. Your own purchases never count.
Earnings wait 30 days. Project deposits, Quests and ad slots also wait until the project is delivered. Refunds cancel the earning.
Payouts from $20, in USDC or USDT to your wallet, sent by hand after a check. We may hold or cancel earnings that look like abuse.
noPage: Invite and earn is for people with a published web3.toys page. Claim yours first, it is free.
walletLine: Where should we send your stablecoins? Use a wallet you control and double-check the network: payments sent to the wrong network cannot be recovered.
